findings: Azure Monitor Replicas and Requests metrics for the demo in New Zealand North were zero or empty for every day since 2026-10-05, including minutes when a replica was running (checked 2026-11-05 06:33-06:50 UTC through the CLI and the REST API).

Cost Management query at resource-group scope returned month-to-date usage quantities on the Azure for Students subscription, although Microsoft lists that offer as unsupported for Cost Management budgets.
Open-month Cost Management amounts price usage at the paid rate and leave the free grant out (AUD 0.042 for usage that is 0.36% of the grant), so the guard compares quantities, not amounts.
Cost Management throttles quickly (HTTP 429 after a few queries); the guard retries four times with backoff and otherwise reports the signal as unavailable.
